name: Orion180 Insurance Group, Inc. Class A
summary: Orion180 Insurance Group, Inc. engages in the provision of innovative insurance solutions, particularly homeowners insurance. It operates through Underwriting and Services segments. The Underwriting segment includes a conventional, regulated insurance model focused on risk selection, pricing, and statutory capital management. The Services segment includes technology-enabled policy servicing operations. The company was founded by Kenneth M. Gregg on May 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Melbourne, FL.
